input: Apply for a press pass for the local film festival

gold.taskTitle: Apply for a Press Pass at Local Film Festival
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to apply for a press pass to gain media access to their local film festival.

questions.title: Which specific film festival are you applying to?
questions.description: Identify the exact name and location of the film festival.

questions.title: What is the application deadline for the press pass?
questions.description: Determine when the press pass application must be submitted by.

questions.title: What media outlet or publication are you representing?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user is applying as a freelancer, staff writer, blogger, podcaster, or other media role.

questions.title: Do you already have a portfolio or published work to submit?
questions.description: Determine if the user has existing clips, articles, or credentials ready to attach to the application.

questions.title: Have you applied for a press pass to this festival before?
questions.description: Find out if the user has prior experience with this specific festival's accreditation process.

questions.title: What type of coverage are you planning to produce?
questions.description: Understand whether the user intends to write reviews, conduct interviews, shoot video, take photographs, or produce another format.

questions.title: Does your outlet have a minimum audience or reach requirement?
questions.description: Clarify if the user knows whether the festival requires proof of readership, followers, or circulation figures.
